evidence: src/services/cardServices.ts: activateCard, getCardStatement, blockCard and unblockCard each repeat `const card = await cardRepository.findById(cardId); if (!card) throw { name: "notFound", message: "⚠ No card found with given ID!" }`
src/services/cardServices.ts getCardStatement: `if (card.isBlocked) throw { name: "badRequest", message: "⚠ This card is blocked!" }` with no checkCardExpiration call

src/services/paymentServices.ts insertPayment and insertOnlinePayment: each repeats the card not-found check, the business not-found check, the `card.isBlocked` 'This card is blocked!' check and `cardUtils.checkCardExpiration(card)`, then calls `cardServices.getCardStatement`, which repeats the not-found and blocked checks
src/services/paymentServices.ts insertOnlinePayment: the card is found via `findByCardDetails`, but the error still says 'No card found with given ID!' (copy-paste drift)
src/services/rechargeService.ts recharge: the same findById, notFound, isBlocked 'This card is blocked!' and checkCardExpiration sequence is copied again
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The three services (card, payment, recharge) share one concern: card-benefit operations. They fail on duplication. The rule "a card must exist, not be blocked and not be expired" is never put in one place. Each service writes it out by hand: findById, then a thrown notFound object, then an isBlocked check that throws badRequest, then cardUtils.checkCardExpiration. The copies don't agree. getCardStatement checks blocked but not expiration. insertPayment checks blocked and expiration and then calls getCardStatement, which repeats the not-found and blocked checks. insertOnlinePayment looks the card up by its details but still reports 'No card found with given ID!'. The module already keeps card checks in cardUtils (checkCardExpiration, checkPassword, checkSecurityCode), yet every service inlines the not-found and blocked checks instead of using a shared guard. The business not-found check is also copied in both payment functions.

violations.message: insertPayment and insertOnlinePayment copy the card-usable check (exists, not blocked, not expired) and the business not-found check instead of sharing one guard. They also call cardServices.getCardStatement, which checks the same things again.
recharge copies the card-usable check (findById, notFound, isBlocked 'This card is blocked!', checkCardExpiration) instead of using a shared guard.

activateCard, getCardStatement, blockCard and unblockCard each repeat the inline card not-found check. getCardStatement's copy of the blocked-card rule leaves out the expiration check that the payment and recharge services apply, so the copies disagree.
